# Preliminary Analysis - Income and Depression Patterns

## Question
How is family income-to-poverty ratio associated with PHQ-9 depression symptom scores among adults aged 18 and older in NHANES 2021–2023?

## Setup 1 - Merging the two NHANES datasets, making the PHQ-9 score variable, and making the categorical age variable
```{r}
#| message: false  
#| warning: false

library(haven)
library(dplyr)

project_root <- normalizePath(
  system2("git", c("rev-parse", "--show-toplevel"), stdout = TRUE),
  mustWork = TRUE
)
raw_dir <- file.path(project_root, "data", "raw")
data_dir <- file.path(project_root, "data")

demographics <- read_xpt(file.path(raw_dir, "DEMO_L.xpt"))
depression <- read_xpt(file.path(raw_dir, "DPQ_L.xpt"))

stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(demographics$SEQN), !anyDuplicated(depression$SEQN))

nhanes_merged <- inner_join(demographics, depression, by = "SEQN")
stopifnot(nrow(nhanes_merged) == n_distinct(nhanes_merged$SEQN))

dpq_items <- paste0("DPQ0", seq(10, 90, by = 10))
nhanes_merged <- nhanes_merged |>
  mutate(across(
    all_of(dpq_items),
    ~ if_else(.x %in% c(7, 9), NA_real_, .x)
  )) |>
  mutate(
  dpq_score = if_else(
    rowSums(is.na(across(all_of(dpq_items)))) == 0L,
    rowSums(across(all_of(dpq_items))),
    NA_real_
  )
) |>
  mutate(age_cat = cut(
    RIDAGEYR,
    breaks = c(-Inf, 18, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80, Inf),
    right = FALSE,
    include.lowest = TRUE,
    ordered_result = TRUE,
    labels = c("<18", "18-29", "30-39", "40-49", "50-59", "60-69", "70-79", "80+")
  ))

write.csv(
  nhanes_merged,
  file.path(data_dir, "nhanes_merged.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE,
  na = ""
)

nrow(nhanes_merged)
```

## Setup 2 - Importing the new dataset
```{r}
#| message: false  
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(gt)
library(gtsummary)

nhanes <- read_csv(
  file.path(project_root, "data", "nhanes_merged.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

submission_dir <- file.path(
  project_root,
  "milestones",
  "m2-preliminary-analysis",
  "submission"
)
```

## Cohort
We limited the analysis to adults aged 18 years and older. All 6,337 records in the merged dataset met this age criterion, so no records were removed at this step. Missing income and PHQ-9 scores were assessed before selecting complete cases for the analysis.
```{r}
adult_cohort <- nhanes |>
  filter(RIDAGEYR >= 18)

cohort_counts <- tibble(
  step = c("Prepared file", "After age 18+ restriction"),
  n = c(nrow(nhanes), nrow(adult_cohort))
)

kable(cohort_counts)
```

## Missingness

Missingness for family income-to-poverty ratio and PHQ-9 score was assessed among all adults aged 18 years and older before restricting the data to complete cases.

```{r}
# AI prompt: Help draft code to summarize missingness for INDFMPIR and dpq_score before complete-case filtering and export the result as a CSV.
# Verified: Missing counts were independently checked using is.na() on the adult cohort.

key_vars <- c("INDFMPIR", "dpq_score")

missingness_summary <- adult_cohort |>
  summarise(
    across(
      all_of(key_vars),
      ~ sum(is.na(.x))
    )
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "missing_n"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    total_n = nrow(adult_cohort),
    missing_percent = 100 * missing_n / total_n,
    variable = recode(
      variable,
      INDFMPIR = "Family income-to-poverty ratio",
      dpq_score = "PHQ-9 total score"
    )
  )

missingness_summary |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(
    title = "Missingness in Key Analysis Variables",
    subtitle = "Adults aged 18 years and older, NHANES 2021–2023"
  ) |>
  cols_label(
    variable = "Variable",
    missing_n = "Missing, n",
    total_n = "Cohort N",
    missing_percent = "Missing (%)"
  ) |>
  fmt_number(
    columns = missing_percent,
    decimals = 1
  ) |>
  opt_row_striping()

write_csv(
  missingness_summary,
  file.path(submission_dir, "missingness-summary.csv")
)
```

## Analytic sample

After documenting missingness, we restricted the analysis to adults with non-missing family income-to-poverty ratio and PHQ-9 scores.

```{r}
analysis_df <- adult_cohort |>
  filter(
    !is.na(INDFMPIR),
    !is.na(dpq_score)
  )

nrow(analysis_df)
```

## Table 1 style summary

The analytic sample included participants with non-missing family income-to-poverty ratio and PHQ-9 scores. Continuous characteristics are summarized using mean (SD).

```{r}
# Verified: Analytic N and mean (SD) values for age, INDFMPIR, and PHQ-9 matched independent calculations.
table1 <- analysis_df |>
  select(
    RIDAGEYR,
    INDFMPIR,
    dpq_score
  ) |>
  tbl_summary(
    statistic = all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd})",
    digits = list(
      RIDAGEYR ~ 1,
      INDFMPIR ~ 2,
      dpq_score ~ 1
    ),
    label = list(
      RIDAGEYR ~ "Age, years",
      INDFMPIR ~ "Family income-to-poverty ratio",
      dpq_score ~ "PHQ-9 total score"
    ),
    missing = "no"
  ) |>
  bold_labels() |>
  modify_caption("**Table 1. Characteristics of the Analytic Sample**")

table1

table1_csv <- table1 |>
  as_tibble(col_labels = FALSE)

write_csv(
  table1_csv,
  file.path(submission_dir, "table1.csv")
)
```
